audience: support teams who work a shared inbox in Groove

useCases.title: Find open conversations that nobody owns
useCases.text: The AI lists conversations filtered by state and assignment, so you see open tickets with no agent. It can open one to read its subject, contact, channel and tags.

useCases.title: Search conversations by keyword or tag
useCases.text: The AI searches conversations by keywords, tag, channel, folder or starred flag, for example all open tickets tagged billing, and summarizes what they are about.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and how often they wrote in
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by name or email and reads their role, type and number of conversations.

useCases.title: Assign conversations to an agent or team
useCases.text: The AI assigns a conversation to an agent, a team or both, after it looks up the agent or team ids.

useCases.title: Tag or untag conversations
useCases.text: The AI looks up the tag ids and then adds tags to a conversation or removes them, one conversation after another.

useCases.title: Close, reopen, snooze or star conversations
useCases.text: The AI closes resolved conversations, reopens closed or snoozed ones, snoozes one until a time you give, or stars it for attention.
